name: Mountain Druid
summary: A highland guardian who masters cliffs, altitude, immovability, giant forms, and living stone.

featureOverrides.summary: Unlock Huge or Diminutive animals and Medium elementals; plant forms are unavailable.
Assume the form of a Large giant as giant form I; plant forms are unavailable.
Gain another daily use and Huge elemental forms; plant forms are unavailable.
Assume the form of a Huge giant as giant form II and gain another daily use.

features.name: Mountaineer
features.summary: In mountain terrain, add half Druid level to initiative, Climb, and key exploration skills and leave no trail.

features.name: Sure-Footed
features.summary: Ignore movement, Acrobatics, and Stealth penalties from steep slopes, rubble, and scree.

features.name: Spire Walker
features.summary: Retain Dexterity while climbing, ignore altitude sickness, and ignore cold-climate effects.

features.name: Mountain Stance
features.summary: Become immune to petrification and gain +4 against effects that physically move you.

features.name: Mountain Stone
features.summary: Transform into a weathered stone outcrop and back at will as statue.
